reasoning: China's youth unemployment (16-24, excluding students) was 16.5% in December 2025. The question asks if it will fall below 15% in any monthly report by July 2026. Historical data shows the rate reached 13.2% in June 2024, demonstrating sub-15% is achievable. However, the rate peaked at 18.9% in August 2025 due to graduate influx. Seasonal patterns show rates typically decline in fall/winter and rise in summer. From January-July 2026, we'd see winter/spring months (potentially lower) before summer graduate surge. Given structural challenges persist but the rate was declining (18.9% to 16.5%), there's reasonable chance it could dip below 15% in early 2026 before summer.
